consumers: printing 5.15.1 Windows/Linux plugin, PDFIUM_VERSION pinned by windows/pdfium_pin.cmake and linux/pdfium_pin.cmake
enforcement: The runner install step fails unless the single bundled library equals binarySha256 for the target.
notices: All four archives contain the same 18 license files as the macOS arm64 archive bundled in assets/notices/native-macos-arm64. Seventeen are identical after line-ending normalization; licenses/pdfium.txt has the same words but without the '//' comment prefixes. The in-app notices therefore cover these targets.
pluginApiCheck: Every FPDF function and type used by printing 5.15.1 (windows/*.cpp, linux/*.cc) is declared in the chromium/8125 headers.
runtimeLimit: Printing UI stays hidden on Windows/Linux: the printing plugin calls FPDF_InitLibraryWithConfig/FPDF_DestroyLibrary on the same library the reader uses.
